about: Tycho's one budget: the app wasm's size, gated by `just tycho check` (perf/size.ts). Tycho records no other measurement (root docs/DECISIONS.md, 'Measurement protocol', 2026-11-17), so it has no metrics and `report` skips it.

wasmOverBaseline.what: `check`: app wasm (brotli) over perf/baseline.json's `wasmBrotliKiB`, as a fraction, unless a perf/budget-notes.md row accepts the size
